failure_cases.must_fail_when: The decision packet omits or alters the exact p2-75 approval phrase.
Generic language such as continue, go ahead, or all done is treated as approval.
The packet does not carry the 75-operation p2-87 preview evidence.
Hash match, body unchanged, non-status frontmatter unchanged, or old-write counts are wrong.
The decision packet claims to authorize or execute old-file writes.
The artifact marks p2-75 exact approval as collected.
The packet implies merge, promotion, reviewed knowledge, evidence support, or action basis.
The packet lacks withhold, revise, or reject/park options.
